gui.worlddegrade.title: World Degrade
gui.worlddegrade.warning: Affects ALL player-built structures in this dimension!
gui.worlddegrade.corrupt_computers.toolt: Garbles the files on ComputerCraft computers, turtles and floppy disks the run reaches. Undo restores them.
gui.worlddegrade.adv.title: Advanced — Custom Percentages
chat.worlddegrade.contraptions: Disassembling and degrading %s assembled Create contraption(s)...
chat.worlddegrade.done: Degradation complete: %s blocks affected across %s chunks. Use /degrade undo to revert.
chat.worlddegrade.nothing: No tracked player-built structures found in that area.
chat.worlddegrade.area.started: Degrading %s chunk(s) and %s contraption(s)/ship(s) in the given area at level %s...
chat.worlddegrade.area.toobig: Area too large: at most %s chunks may be selected at once (you requested %s).
chat.worlddegrade.area.out_of_world: Selection is entirely outside this dimension's build height (%s to %s).
chat.worlddegrade.busy: A degradation or undo is already running — wait for it to finish.
chat.worlddegrade.no_permission: You do not have permission to degrade structures.
chat.worlddegrade.dimension_disabled: World Degrade is disabled in this dimension.
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.disabled: The degradation schedule is disabled or empty in the server config.
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.toobig: Too many chunks for one schedule.
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.nothing: Nothing to schedule there — those chunks are already scheduled or the dimension is disabled.
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.list.paused: — paused, the schedule is disabled in the server config
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.list.nopass: — no matching pass in the current config
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.untracked: Warning: placement tracking is off (enablePlacementTracking = false), so no blocks are being recorded. Scheduled passes will find nothing to degrade outside marked regions.
chat.worlddegrade.schedule.cancelled.all: Cancelled %s degradation schedule(s) in this dimension.
chat.worlddegrade.opac.unavailable: The OPAC integration is not active (Open Parties and Claims is not installed).
chat.worlddegrade.opac.simulated: Simulating an OPAC claim expiration over %s chunk(s); an OPAC schedule will appear within ~2 seconds (see /degrade schedule list).
chat.worlddegrade.opac.simulated.note: No claim setup is needed: this degrades placement-tracked (built) blocks in those chunks regardless of claims. The claim-removal step only ever runs on chunks OPAC has genuinely expired, so it does nothing here — pass 'true' as the last argument to also force the chunks into OPAC's expired state and watch the auto-unclaim.
chat.worlddegrade.opac.simulated.expire: Forced %s chunk(s) into OPAC's expired-claim state, overwriting any existing claim there. The claim(s) will be dropped automatically after the configured removeClaimAfter pass (unless it is NEVER).
chat.worlddegrade.inspect.yes: %s at %s is EXEMPT (%s) — kept untouched by every degradation effect.
chat.worlddegrade.inspect.no: %s at %s is NOT exempt — it will degrade normally.
chat.worlddegrade.inspect.removed: %s at %s is NOT exempt — a datapack block_category remove re-enabled decay (override beats tag and built-in).
chat.worlddegrade.inspect.notarget: Look at a block within 20 blocks, or pass a position: /degrade inspect <x y z>.
gui.worlddegrade.mark.title: Mark this box as player-made?
chat.worlddegrade.wand.given: Marking wand received. Right-click two corners, then right-click inside the box to confirm. Sneak-right-click clears; sneak-left-click deletes a box.
chat.worlddegrade.wand.toobig: Box too big — each edge must be at most %s blocks (yours is %s).
chat.worlddegrade.generate.reload: Wrote datapacks/worlddegrade-generated. Run /reload (or restart) to load the new chains.
chat.worlddegrade.generate.backup: Re-running generate overwrites everything under worlddegrade-generated — back up manual edits in chains/ first.
chat.worlddegrade.generate.failed: Failed to write the generated datapack: %s
